scope: Source and local actual socket tests for public announce-list probes; not deployed-image/all-tracker/full-security acceptance

policy.dns: Every answer must be public; connect only to numeric vetted IP without a second lookup
policy.http: No proxy, cookies or redirects; platform TLS validation; response headers only; success or HTTP 400 reachability
policy.udp: BEP 15 connection request and matching action/transaction response; send alone is not success
policy.private_urls: Decode before validation; exclude userinfo/query/fragment/nested encoding/arbitrary paths

local_socket_evidence: Literal loopback rejected before TCP connection
Pinned original hostname connects to selected test IP without DNS
HTTP 302 response does not contact redirect target
Actual UDP BEP 15 request/reply succeeds only after matching response
Short, wrong-transaction and error-action packets rejected
limitations: New announce policy not yet deployed or exercised across public trackers
Conservative path/address restrictions and bounded cycle can produce a partial tracker list
